title: A Distorted Filolial
paragraphs: After all that, we arrived at another mansion—disguised as a forest, or rather a small hill—located at the end of a labyrinthine passageway. However, while this place also had countless traps, it was empty.

For some reason, the exit was behind the throne—but is there any significance to having a throne in a place like that? So, when we proceeded through the unexplored sections of the underground passageway… we emerged into an underground harbor. A gap in the quay served as the exit, and seawater was flowing in.
“Just as I expected—they got away.”
“So they did sense us after all…”

“They don’t seem to have gotten very far yet, so if we expand our search to the surrounding waters, I think we’ll track them down. I’d bet there are some folks out there who want to watch us blow up.”
“That’s in poor taste.”
Father turns his gaze from the harbor out to sea.
“They probably built a submarine or something…”
That’s entirely possible.
“Then let’s have Gaelion dive down and give chase!”
Our Rival transformed into a Water-type dragon and dove into the sea.
“…For now, maybe we should leave the investigation to them and head back to our base ship?”
“Hmm… There’s still a chance they’re hiding in the forest. There might be another secret passage somewhere.”
Just as we were returning to the ship we’d docked at, a member of the communications team who had been inside the ship came rushing out. He looked rather flustered.
“Hero! It’s an emergency!”
“What’s wrong? Did something happen?”
“We’ve just received an emergency transmission reporting that countless mysterious monsters are currently rampaging near the capitals of countries all over the world!”
“What!? Give me the details!”
“The information is still conflicting… Please hurry back, Hero!”
“Got it! Gaelion-chan! Hurry over here!”
Father summoned Rival via the Monster Seal. Rival leapt out of the ocean and landed on the ship.
“What’s going on?”
“I heard there have been attacks on capitals around the world!”
“Hmm… we’ve been had. It’s highly likely that information was fed to us on purpose… it’s safe to say the Remnant Eradication Society was used.”
Rival seems to be feeling a certain sympathy.
“Let’s go, Motoyasu-kun!”
“Understood!”
And so, we ended up turning around and heading back.
Upon returning to Siltvelt, the monstrous threat itself appeared right before our eyes.
“Gueeeeeee!”
“Gueeeeeeeee!”
That monster was… It was… Filolial-sama!? Countless Filolial-samas were rampaging freely throughout the capital of Siltvelt, damaging buildings and people, wreaking utter havoc.
“Filolial-sama!?”
“No, something’s different from a normal Filolial-sama! But they’re also different from Sakura-chan and the others!”
“Oh, is that Plum-chan!? It’s Kii-kun!”

Yes, I could tell at a glance that this was Filolial-sama I’d taken care of during previous runs. However, its appearance was so ravaged it was painful to look at—it was in such a tattered state that “tattered” was the only way to describe it. It’s a grotesque form, different from both ordinary Filolials and the King or Queen.

Feathers spill unnaturally from her legs, yet her upper body remains slender… her feathers are patchy in places, and her beak has lost its luster. One of her eyes is unnaturally large… I can’t bear to look at her!?
“Stop rampaging!”

Filolial-sama, who is guarding the castle, is charging at Plum-chan and the others, who are running amok, in an attempt to subdue them. However, Filolial-sama cannot bear to see sadness. It seems unable to fight with a clear conscience and is struggling.
“Stop it, I say!”
It’s absolutely unacceptable for two Filolial-sama to fight each other! Just as I instinctively started to run toward them, Yuki-chan stepped in front of me to hold me back.
“Motoyasu-sama! You mustn’t go!”
“Yuki-chan, please don’t get in my way! Filolial-sama is being made to run amok in a truly pitiful manner right before Plum-chan and the others’ eyes! We must stop this immediately!”
“No! Lord Motoyasu, please tell me first how you plan to stop them. You’re going to subdue her with paralysis, confusion, or whatever it takes, aren’t you?”
“I can’t do that!”
Yuki-chan’s grip on me grows even tighter.
“Then it’s out of the question! I can’t let you go, Lord Motoyasu!”
“Yuki-chan! Please let go of me!　Aaaahhh…!?”
Right before my eyes, Plum-chan is being casually grabbed by the neck by Filolial-sama and swung around violently! Are you seriously telling me to just stand by and watch this hellish scene!?
“Lord Motoyasu, please leave this to me, Yuki!”
“Yuki-chan, do you have a plan?”
“I don’t have a concrete plan. But I simply cannot let Lord Motoyasu go there!”
As I lost all self-control and tried to rush into the fight between Filolial-sama and the others, Yuki-chan desperately stopped me and said,
“Naofumi-sama, please take on the role of keeping Motoyasu-sama here. Yuki’s strength alone isn’t enough…”
“Yeah, you’re right. I got it.”

Just as I was about to shake off Yuki-chan’s hold and dash off, Father grabbed my hand and pulled me back. Father is a Hero just like me, and since he’s already been sufficiently enhanced, even I can’t easily shake off his grip.
“Motoyasu, let’s leave this to Yuki and the others.”
“B-but!”
“If you go out there, you’ll only get in the way. You need to hold back for now. Trust Yuki-chan.”
“Ugh… uuuuuuugh…”
There’s no way I can shake off Father’s grip right now. But does that mean I have no choice but to just stand by and let Yuki-chan and the others handle this on their own?!
“Naofumi-sama, thank you so much for stopping Motoyasu-sama. Well then, here we go! Kou, Sakura! The rest of you, follow me!”
“Nooo!”
“I don’t want to!”
Sakura-chan and Kou are both clearly uncomfortable with this tense atmosphere. And rightfully so. After all, it’s absolutely unacceptable for Filolial-sama to fight among themselves!

“Protesting here won’t make the problem go away! Even if they’re our own kind, anyone who stands in our way must be eliminated… no, precisely because they’re our own kind, we must stop them! Just look at the others. We are Filolial-sama, representing the Heroes. As representatives, we must not run away!”
Yuki-chan jumps into the fray, stepping between the rampaging Filolial-samas and glaring at them.
“Gueeeeeeeeeeeah!”
The distorted Filolial-sama, undeterred, raises his leg toward Yuki-chan, attempting to kick her away.
“Don’t move!”
But Yuki-chan fixed the distorted Filolial-sama with a piercing gaze and, holding her hand out in front of her, commanded,
“I will not tolerate any further acts of violence! As a candidate for Queen of Filolial, I hereby arrest you all!”
“Gueeeee… G…”

Stared down by Yuki-chan’s piercing gaze, the Distorted Filolial-sama’s leg—which had been poised to kick—froze in place, and she took a few steps back as if overwhelmed. She seems to be trying to pounce again and again, but for some reason, the Distorted Filolial-sama just keeps letting out threatening growls, as if she’s unable to actually attack.
“Ah… So that legend really did exist! Thank you so much!”
The villager from Siltvelt, who had been protected by Filolial-sama, clasped his hands together in prayer toward Yuki-chan as a sign of gratitude. What on earth is this guy talking about?
“What do you mean…?”
Yuki-chan furrowed her brow slightly and tilted her head in confusion.
“…I see. That’s Filolial for you.”
Rival crossed her arms and spoke as if she’d come to a realization.
“Did you figure something out, Gaelion?”
“Yuki, Sakura, and Kou—you guys should already understand the answer. Or do I really need to spell it out for you?”
Rival says this to Yuki-chan and the others in a provocative tone. To say something like that during such an emergency—she really doesn’t know how to read the room!
“Hmm?”
Sakura-chan tilts her head slightly, looking confused, while Kou nods, glancing at me and Zou.
“Pickup line?”
“Why ‘pickup line’? I mean, I think you figured something out, but could you explain it a little more clearly?”
Yuki holds up one hand toward Filolial-sama, who’s about to pounce.
“Don’t move. Stay right where you are.”
“Guh…!? G… Gg!”
That’s right—the distorted Filolial-sama, ordered by Yuki-chan, seemed unable to move even if she wanted to and simply sat down right there.
Oh? What on earth is going on here?
“I see… so this is another of her privileges, isn’t it? Now then, Sakura, Kou! I’m going to give a loud command to the rampaging Filolials. That way, this pointless brawl will end right away.”
“Got it!”
“Got it!”

Sakura-chan and Kou nodded and, just as Yuki-chan had ordered, began issuing commands to the distorted Filolial-samas. As a result, the distorted Filolial-samas were helplessly restrained, their movements suppressed. Of course, there are some who try to ignore the command and lunge forward, but their movements visibly slow down, allowing the other Filolial-samas to safely subdue them.
It’s… a miracle! A true miracle! The battle has ended without a single drop of a Filolial-sama’s blood being spilled!
“Ah… so that’s how it is.”
“Father, have you figured something out?”
I ask Father.

“Yuki-chan and the others are different from the other Filolials—they’ve been granted wings by Ms. Fitoria as the next successors. So, in a sense, they’re superior individuals… I think it means that Filolials are likely programmed in such a way that they instinctively find it hard to defy orders from higher beings.”
“Earlier, Kou-san mentioned ‘picking up girls,’ didn’t he? I heard he learned that when he went out with the Spear Hero before…”
Zou’s words reminded me of the time I went out with Kou. It’s true—Kou was more of a playboy than I was and managed to take out plenty of Filolial-sama ladies.
“What…? So that’s why Kou was able to pick up more Filolial-sama ladies than I could? No, it’s because Kou has more of a playboy’s flair than I do.”
“So for you, Motoyasu, what’s important isn’t his ability to give orders, but proving that Kou is a playboy?”
Father is looking rather exasperated for some reason. Even if you say that, Kou is a boy, after all—it’s a necessary part of being one!
“Naofumi, you’re the Spear Hero.”
“Mm-hmm, that’s right. Iwatan-san, it’d be easier to just give up on trying to make Kitamura-san see things my way.”
“Well, that’s true, I guess. He’s just a bit slow on the uptake—I really wish he’d catch on and understand right here.”
“I have no intention of denying Kou’s charm.”

“Motoyasu-kun’s good qualities are getting in the way of his flashes of insight… Well, that’s fine, I guess. Basically, I think it just means that commands work more effectively on those strange Filolial-samas.”
At this point, Yuki-chan nods while stopping the movements of the distorted Filolial-samas.
“Yes, I sensed it. If my intuition is correct, I believe the effect on those who have rightfully become Queen or King is quite low.”

I see. If Yuki-chan says so, it must be true! The Filolial-sama are a race brimming with individuality, but they’re also a race that excels at group living. That means there are rules unique to the Filolial-sama.
“Either way, Yuki-chan, Sakura-chan, and Kou! Let’s subdue these rampaging Filolials as quickly as possible!”
“Understood.”
“Got it!”
“I’ll do my best to stop them!”
“Motoyasu-kun can’t fight, so stay put! Lars-chan and the others, fall back too!”
Father raises his shield and steps forward to protect me from Filolial-sama, who is charging toward us.
“Gueeeeeee!”
“Gueeeeeeeee!”
Father is blocking every attack that comes at him, undeterred by their relentless onslaught. Sakura-chan immediately rushes over and gives the order.
“Don’t move—you have to stay still!”
“Guu—”
“Eeeee—”
Thanks to Sakura-chan’s command, we managed to forcibly restrain the distorted Filolial-sama.
“Seriously, there’s just no helping you guys.”

Rival transforms into a massive dragon and takes flight, soaring off in a direction opposite from where Yuki-chan and the others are holding him down… and begins spewing what looks like gas all over Siltvelt.
“If we hurt him carelessly, the Spear Hero is likely to make a fuss—what are we going to do?”
“We’ll just have to turn a blind eye to minor injuries. Lord Rasa and Lord Elmelo surely understand that well enough. We just need to make sure it can’t continue fighting.”
“Capturing monsters is such a common request, after all.”
“True… If we use Magic, subduing it shouldn’t be that difficult.”
Éclair and the others split up to help subdue Filolial-sama.
“Come on, Motoyasu-kun.”
“Ugh…”
It’s so frustrating that I can’t do anything. Oh, Filolial-sama, you mustn’t thrash about like that! While screaming that in my heart, all I could do was watch as events unfolded.
